Subject: Initial supplier onboarding & procurement checklist for Aurora Analytics

Hi Samantha,

Thanks for choosing Redwood — excited to get Aurora set up as a vendor. I'm kicking off procurement onboarding for billing and vendor setup. To keep things moving, please find below what we need from you and what we will provide on our side.

What we need from Aurora (please attach in reply):
- Completed vendor setup form (fillable PDF or signed PDF)
- W-9 (or applicable tax form) and legal entity name
- Bank details for ACH (account name, routing, account number) OR instructions for wire transfers
- Copy of standard terms or any procurement-specific requirements
- Primary billing contact and PO processing email
- Remit-to address and initial invoice example (PDF or XLS)

What Redwood will provide:
- Redwood's Supplier Onboarding packet (PO process, payment terms, e-invoicing)
- Purchase order template and instructions
- Point of contact in Procurement: Dev Patel (procurement) and Finance: Naomi Feldman
- Expected payment terms: Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated

Can you confirm you can return the vendor form and W-9 by EOD Wednesday (Jan 21)? If you prefer a DocuSign, we can send one — let us know.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Thanks Samantha — appreciate the fast turnaround and the attachments. A couple of operational details so we can complete vendor setup and issue a PO: 

1) PO and invoice flow:
- We do require a Redwood PO number on invoices for payments to be processed through our AP queue.
- Procurement will issue the initial PO within 2 business days after the completed vendor form and W-9 are uploaded to our vendor portal.

2) Invoicing specifics:
- Please include your invoice number, invoice date, remit-to address, and the bank instructions or ACH details on a separate secured attachment. We cannot accept bank account numbers in plaintext in email.
- Preferred invoice format: PDF (single-page summary) + XLS or CSV for line item export if available.

3) Payment terms and exceptions:
- Standard Redwood term is Net 30. If Aurora requests Net 45/60, please flag that as an exception and we'll route to Finance for approval.

4) Secure transmission:
- We can send a DocuSign envelope for bank details if that is easier — here's the link we use internally: https://redwood.app/docusign/AA-Setup-2026.

Marissa (Legal), is there anything in the attached Aurora_Standard_Terms.pdf we need to redline up front?

Next steps for Aurora: confirm how you'll send ACH details (DocuSign vs secure portal), and if possible attach an example invoice (PDF or template). Once we have that, Procurement will issue PO and confirm expected payment date.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
